title: Student behavior and interaction patterns with an lms as motivation predictors in e-learning settings
reason: LMS logs (hits, forum use, profile-photo upload, weekly-use coefficient of variation) related to Academic Motivation Scale indexes by group means, t-tests and ANOVA. Meets I2. Grades are related only to questionnaire motivation, not to log measures.

extraction.notes: Tables V, VII, VIII give only group means of motivation by hits band, forum-use band and time-pattern regularity (e.g. e-learning motivation 2.32 for <150 hits vs 4.19 for >450). ANOVA for regularity reported as significant without a statistic or p. Grade-motivation t-test p values are equation images missing from text. No correlation coefficients. Table I ANOVA compares grades and hits across the three course offerings, not hits against grades.
